description:
-= Attic =-
You've just sauntered into an attic.

You see a crate.

There is an unblocked exit to the east. You need an unguarded exit? You should try going north.

There is a golf tee on the floor.
objective: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First step, attempt to take a trip east. After that, make absolutely sure that the chest is shut. That's it!
